sources.title: Tukes — Record-keeping for plant protection products
sources.edition: Current authority guidance retrieved 2026-10-16; 2026 requirements; electronic records from 2027

limitations: Maps the information listed by Finland's Tukes guidance; it is a draft record, not a verified Vipu/authority import format.
Units and exact date representation are not fixed in the inspected national guidance; retain the recorded unit and date rather than assuming every treatment is per hectare.
Time of spraying and BBCH are required when product restrictions concern time of day or growth stage; optional markers require case-specific review.
Tukes permits category-level EPPO codes from its national list; individual species codes are optional. No automatic code lookup or product restriction verification is supplied here.

The guidance says electronic records apply from 2027 and that detailed guidelines will be published in late 2026. This 2026 draft does not assert that a published 2027 electronic schema is implemented.
The source requires at least three years of retention for use records; storage/retention compliance is outside the mapping. Biocide, trade and certification variants are separate.
No live filing, authority acceptance, legal compliance certification or complete regional/scheme coverage is established.
